parameters.help_en:
The scene type. Valid values:
briefing-voiceover: News broadcast (supplements voiceover with B-roll footage or uses no digital human).
creator-talk: Creator talk (multi-shot, news, science, or finance).
creator-sales: Creator sales (three-part structure for product promotion, review, or store visit).
avatar-broadcast: Digital human broadcast (fixed single shot for broadcast, announcement, or template)
parameters.help_zh:
场景类型，可选：
briefing-voiceover，资讯播报（基于口播补充镜头画面/无数字人）
creator-talk，达人讲解（多分镜 · 资讯/科普/财经）
creator-sales，达人带货（三段式 · 带货/测评/探店）
avatar-broadcast，数字人播报（固定单镜 · 播报/公告/模板）
parameters.name: scene_type

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio. Valid values: 16:9 (default), 9:16, 4:3, and 3:4
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.help_en: The output languages. The value is a JSON array string. Valid values: CN, EN, and YUE. The `avatar-broadcast` and `creator-sales` scenes support only CN
parameters.help_zh:
输出语种，Json Array String，可选 CN/EN/YUE
`avatar-broadcast`、`creator-sales`仅支持选择中文
parameters.name: output_languages

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include subtitles. Default value: true
parameters.name: with_subtitles

parameters.help_en:
The list of user materials. The value is a JSON array string. This parameter includes the following fields:
MediaId: The media asset ID. This is the ID of the image or video uploaded to Wanjing Yike.
Type: The media type.
Action: The method of using the material. Valid values: `match` (matches and selects suitable segments from the video material based on the voiceover) and `insert` (inserts the video material before the CTA shot based on intelligent analysis after generating shots from the voiceover; valid only for videos). Default value: `match`
parameters.help_zh:
用户素材列表，Json Array String，包含字段：
MediaId：媒资ID（上传到万镜一刻的图片或视频）
Type：媒体类型
Action：素材使用方式，可选：`match`（匹配方式，基于口播选择视频素材中适合的片段）；`insert`（插入方式，选择视频素材插入CTA分镜前（基于口播生成分镜后智能分析），仅对视频有效）；默认 `match`
parameters.name: user_materials

parameters.help_en:
The digital human information. The value is a JSON string. This parameter is required for the `creator-talk`, `creator-sales`, and `avatar-broadcast` scenes. It includes the following fields:
AvatarPortrait: The digital human avatar. This field is required. The value is a string that specifies the media asset ID of the portrait image or the image URL.
AvatarVoice: The digital human voice. This field is optional. The value is a string that specifies the audio ID of the human voice or the audio URL
parameters.help_zh:
数字人信息，Json String，`creator-talk`、`creator-sales`、`avatar-broadcast`场景必填，包含字段：
AvatarPortrait，数字人形象，必填，String，人像图片媒资 ID 或 图片URL
AvatarVoice，数字人音色，选填，String，人声音频ID或 音频URL
parameters.name: avatar_data

parameters.example: {\"TextType\":2,\"TextContent\":\"Today, Beijing held a press conference to announce plans to further optimize the city's transportation network, including adding three new subway lines within the next three years....\"}
parameters.help_en:
The job parameters. The value is a JSON string. This parameter includes the following fields:
TextType: The text type. This field is required. The value is an integer. Valid values: 1 (original draft, such as product or news information, which the system automatically converts into a voiceover script) and 2 (voiceover script).
TextContent: The text content. This field is required. The value is a string. The maximum length is 10,000 characters.
VoiceDuration: The expected voiceover duration. This field is optional. The value is an integer. Set this field when TextType is set to 1. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60. The final video duration will be slightly shorter than the expected duration.
NarrationVoiceId: The narration voice ID. The value is a string. This field is valid only for the `briefing-voiceover` scene
parameters.help_zh:
任务参数，Json String，包含：
TextType，Integer，必填，文本类型，1-原始稿（商品或资讯信息，系统自动转为口播稿）；2-口播稿；
TextContent，String，必填，文本内容，最大长度10000字符
VoiceDuration，Integer，选填，预期口播时长，当TextType==1时设置，单位：秒，默认60s，最终成片会略少于预期时长
NarrationVoiceId，String，旁白音色ID，仅对`briefing-voiceover`有效
parameters.name: job_params

parameters.help_en:
The custom parameters. The value is a JSON string. The value is returned as-is in query or callback results. The maximum length is 8,192 characters. System reserved words:
NotifyAddress: The callback URL. The URL must start with http:// or https://. The maximum length is 2,048 characters. The system sends a callback to this URL after the node reaches the desired state.
UserId: The UID of the actual resource ownership. If this field is missing, the system falls back to CallerUid
parameters.help_zh:
自定义参数，Json String，查询/回调结果原样携带，最大长度 8192。系统保留字段：
NotifyAddress：回调地址 URL（须 http(s)://，最大 2048），任务终态后回调
UserId：真实资源归属 uid（缺失时回落 CallerUid）
parameters.name: user_data

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when the job is in the Failed state
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，Failed 状态下返回
